summary: Enrolled students (including those scheduled to return from leave) who have completed at least two regular semesters and earned at least 33 credits may apply for a double, interdisciplinary, minor, linked or student-designed major for Spring 2027. Applications are made online through mySNU, from 12 October 2026 (09:00) to 16 October 2026 (18:00) for double and interdisciplinary majors, and from 26 October 2026 (09:00) to 30 October 2026 (18:00) for minor, linked and student-designed majors. Applicants to the Department of Aerospace Engineering must also email one academic transcript to the department office within the application period, and double-major applicants who pass the document screening will be interviewed.
applies_to: Optional; applies to students who wish to apply for a multiple major (double major, interdisciplinary major, minor, linked major or student-designed major) for Spring 2027. Applicants must be enrolled students (including those scheduled to return from leave) who have completed at least two regular semesters (applications are possible from the third semester onward) and have earned at least 33 credits. For the Department of Aerospace Engineering, double-major and minor applicants must also have completed at least one of the department's required courses and have a GPA of at least 2.7. Student-designed major applicants must have an overall GPA of at least 3.3. Students expected to graduate in the late-term graduation (February 2027) cannot be selected.

conditions: You must have completed at least two regular semesters and earned at least 33 credits to apply.
For the Department of Aerospace Engineering, double-major and minor applicants who have not completed at least one of the department's required courses or whose GPA is below 2.7 will be rejected.
Student-designed major applicants must have an overall GPA of at least 3.3.
The Department of Aerospace Engineering interviews double-major applicants; only those who pass the document screening will be contacted individually with the interview schedule.
A student-designed major is approved only after the online application and submission of the paper application form and related documents.
Students expected to graduate in the late-term graduation (February 2027) cannot be selected.
If you are selected for a double major or minor in the same major you are already pursuing as a multiple major, your existing multiple major in that field is automatically cancelled.
You cannot be selected for both a double major and a minor in the same major in the same academic year and semester; if you are not selected for the double major, you may apply for the minor.
You may apply for at most 3 multiple majors per semester, and at most 6 multiple majors may be completed per person.
If you already have 6 or more multiple majors you cannot apply; with 5 you may apply for 1; with 4 you may apply for 2; with 3 or fewer you may apply for 3.
Credits are generally completed under the curriculum in effect at selection; if credit requirements change, the rules of the relevant department apply.
Students selected from Spring 2025 onward must check the changed completion requirements.
Students completing a double or interdisciplinary major may extend their maximum period of enrolment by one year; for students admitted in or before 2007, minor students may also extend by one year.
For student-designed majors, the enrolment extension applies to new entrants from Spring 2022 onward.

translation:
Spring 2027 Multiple-Major Selection Plan

The selection plan for multiple majors (double and interdisciplinary majors; minors, linked majors and student-designed majors) for the first semester of the 2027 academic year (Spring 2027) is announced as follows.
※ The Department of Aerospace Engineering conducts interviews when selecting double-major students, and the interview schedule will be communicated individually only to those who pass the document screening.

A. Types of selection: double major, interdisciplinary major, minor, linked major, student-designed major

B. Eligibility
○ Common eligibility: enrolled students (including those scheduled to return from leave) who have completed at least two regular semesters (applications possible from the third semester) and earned at least 33 credits
○ Department of Aerospace Engineering criteria (applicants who do not meet the criteria will be rejected)
 - Double major: completion of at least one of the Department of Aerospace Engineering's required courses, GPA of 2.7 or above
 - Minor: completion of at least one of the Department of Aerospace Engineering's required courses, GPA of 2.7 or above
○ Student-designed major: overall GPA of 3.3 or above

C. Application periods
○ Double and interdisciplinary majors: 2026. 10. 12. (Mon) 09:00 – 2026. 10. 16. (Fri) 18:00
○ Minors, linked majors and student-designed majors: 2026. 10. 26. (Mon) 09:00 – 2026. 10. 30. (Fri) 18:00

D. How to apply
○ Students apply themselves on the mySNU (mysnu.ac.kr) website or mobile app: Academic/Administration [학사/행정] > Academic Status Change/Multiple Major [학적변동/다전공] > Apply [신청] > Major/Program Application [전공/과정신청]
 (However, a student-designed major is approved after the online application and submission of a paper application form and related documents.)
○ Applicants seeking to enter the Department of Aerospace Engineering must, after applying online, submit one copy of their academic transcript by email to the department office within the application period (the email address is in the original notice).
※ Recording of selected multiple-major students in the academic record: scheduled for 2027. 1. 15. (Fri)
 * Students expected to graduate in the late-term graduation (2027. 2.) cannot be selected.

E. Main provisions of the Regulations on Major Completion in Undergraduate Programs [학사과정 전공이수 규정]
○ Credits to complete: in principle, credits are completed according to the curriculum at the time of selection; if credit requirements change, the rules set by the relevant department apply. ※ Be sure to check the Department of Aerospace Engineering multiple-major graduation requirements by year of admission (Department of Aerospace Engineering website: Undergraduate [학부] -> Graduation Requirements by Admission Year [학번별졸업이수규정] -> multiple-major requirements by admission year at the bottom). ※ Students selected from Spring 2025 onward must check the changed completion requirements.
○ Extension of the enrolment period: students completing a double or interdisciplinary major may extend their enrolment period by one year. ※ For students admitted in or before the 2007 academic year, minor students may also extend their enrolment period by one year.
※ For student-designed majors, this applies to new entrants from Spring 2022 onward.

F. Points to note
○ If you are selected for a double major or minor in the same major you are already pursuing, the existing multiple major is automatically cancelled.
○ You cannot be selected for both a double major and a minor in the same major in the same academic year/semester (if you are not selected for the double major, you may apply for the minor).
○ Limits on the number of multiple majors per person
 - Maximum number of multiple majors you may apply for per semester: 3
 - Number of multiple majors one person may complete: 6
○ Number of multiple majors you may apply for, by situation
 - Students already pursuing 6 or more multiple majors: cannot apply
 - Students already pursuing 5 multiple majors: may apply for 1
 - Students already pursuing 4 multiple majors: may apply for 2
 - Students already pursuing 3 or fewer multiple majors: may apply for 3
※ The Major Design Support Center [전공설계지원센터] supports students' major exploration and academic planning through major-design counselling. Students interested in multiple majors are encouraged to use the Center and refer to the attached counselling guide (file no. 3). (This file is not among the listed attachments and was not read.)
